plan.purpose: Conditional source-edge Gaussian widths, covariance identifiability, and explicit PSF/response countercontrols; no physical calibration.
limitations: All observations are generated source-pixel means. No uploaded or measured camera data, production trace, image file, or physical calibration is used.
Known unit normals and a single stationary working-image PSF are supplied; uncertainty in normals/pose or variation between edges is not inferred.
Optional variance weighting is a supplied diagonal summary-error hypothesis, not uncertainty derived from the width fits.
Rank three and an SPD Gaussian-equivalent covariance do not validate Gaussian PSF shape, camera response, detector apertures, or a real optical covariance.
Exact common probit response can preserve perfect Gaussian edge fits while rescaling the inferred covariance; covariance/response calibration requires additional evidence.
The finite-D holdout compares a known complete shape using an independent positive area/slice oracle; it is not inverse shape recovery or physical qualification.
All finite-grid, incomplete-refinement, work-limit, tie, boundary, and rank flags are retained. Adverse best candidates are not asserted to be converged intrinsic biases.

independent_quartile_summary_countercont.origin: independent standardized mixture quartile; not pooled optimizer candidates

development_history.correction: The initial mixture label compared its Gaussian-equivalent covariance to base-component Sigma0. The final report uses the supplied mixture second moment 3.4*Sigma0 and names that reference explicitly. Independent source means, fitted candidates, finite-D predictions, plan and numerical pass targets are unchanged.
